name: @riskthinking.ai/cdt-express-mcp
description: Interact with climate metrics via Riskthinking.AI's CDT Express API in supported AI chat experiences

scripts.sync-manifest: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json')); m.version=pkg.version; fs.writeFileSync('manifest.json', JSON.stringify(m, null, 2));"
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run sync-manifest && npm prune --production && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . cdt-express.mcpb && git checkout manifest.json
